import multiprocessing
import sys
import torch
device = sys.argv[sys.argv.index('-device') + 1]
torch.set_num_threads(multiprocessing.cpu_count() if device == 'cpu' else 1)
if device == 'mps':
    torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
from nnunetv2.inference.predict_from_raw_data import predict_entry_point
sys.argv[0] = 'nnUNetv2_predict'
predict_entry_point()
timing_definition: Full nnUNetv2_predict process from launch through exit after saved masks, including Python startup, model loading, preprocessing, prediction and mask export. Output verification is outside the timer. Batch wall time / case count is throughput, not individual-image latency.
process_tree_memory_scope: Sampled sum of RSS for the prediction subprocess and its recursive children only; excludes the benchmark parent. Shared pages can be counted more than once and short-lived peaks or children can be missed. This is not accelerator peak memory.
